blurb: Shining Horizons offers therapeutic riding and equine-assisted therapy programs designed to support emotional, physical, and cognitive well-being. Programs serve children, youth, and adults, including neurodiverse individuals and trauma survivors. Activities include horseback riding, horse care, and unmounted therapy sessions led by licensed therapists.
